programme.title: Ignoring My Crush For 24 Hours… *prank*

programme.title: Surprising Zoey With Her Dream Gaming Setup
programme.desc: Nico teams up with a friend to completely overhaul a dated gaming desk and PC over 2 intense days. They assemble a brand new high-end white PC, install triple monitors, and add custom lighting just before Zoey arrives to see the massive upgrade.

programme.title: We’re TRAPPED Inside A BLOCK In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Today, Nico and Cash are trapped inside a BLOCK in Minecraft! They need to survive by traveling to each mega block in this void world. What will they find on each block and how will they get back home?

programme.title: Cash Has A CRUSH In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Today, Nico and his friends welcome a new permanent neighbor in Minecraft, discovering that it's a girl. Who is this new neighbor and what makes her special? Watch to find out!

programme.title: Zoey Is MISSING In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Today, Zoey goes missing in Minecraft after an accident occurs in her candy shop. Nico must figure out who is responsible for her disappearance. Watch to find out how he uncovers the mystery!

programme.title: I Cheated with a PROFESSIONAL Builder in a Building Challenge!
programme.desc: Today, Nico and Cash compete in a Minecraft build challenge. Unbeknownst to Cash, Nico is secretly using the help of a professional builder, Zoey. Will Cash discover Nico's secret, or will Nico secure victory without getting caught?

programme.title: Rating My Friends In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Today, Nico rates his friends in Minecraft! He creates a gameshow and judges their performances. Who will win Nico's game show? Watch to find out!

programme.title: I Had a Sleepover with My Crush..
programme.desc: Nico shares the experience of having a sleepover with his crush, likely filled with fun, awkward, and memorable moments.

programme.title: We Turned Into ANIMALS In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Nico and his friends get trapped in the zoo in Minecraft, turning into animals and getting taken to enclosures. Watch to see how they escape and turn back into humans!

programme.title: 100 Hardest Minecraft YouTuber Challenges
programme.desc: I take on 100 of the hardest Minecraft YouTuber challenges back to back to see how many I can actually complete without failing.

programme.title: Nico vs Cash STATUES House Battle In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Nico and Cash argue over whose statue is better and go head to head to see who can build the better statue house to live in.

programme.title: Nico LEAVES His Family In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Nico leaves his family behind in Minecraft and travels into the future, where he has to take on real adult responsibilities for the first time.

programme.title: Nico Finds A MAGICAL GENIE In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Nico finds a magical genie in Minecraft that can grant three wishes to him and his friends, but its powers turn out to be way beyond anyone's imagination.

programme.title: Adopted By A DRAGON FAMILY In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Nico and Cash end up getting adopted by a family of dragons in Minecraft, and have to adjust to their strange and fiery new way of life.

programme.title: Nico Can READ MINDS In Minecraft!
programme.desc: Nico gains the power to read minds in Minecraft and uses it to uncover his friends' deepest secrets, whether for good or for pure mischief.

programme.title: Nico vs Cash MILLIONAIRE House Battle in Minecraft!
programme.desc: Nico and Cash go head to head in a Minecraft building competition to see who can build the better millionaire house, packed with riches and security.

programme.title: Pod Save America
programme.desc: With two weeks until the midterms, Amy Walter, publisher and editor-in-chief of the Cook Political Report, sits down with Dan to break down what she calls the most brutal political environment Republicans have faced in twenty years. They discuss whether the numbers indicate a "blue wave" or a "red undertow," whether the polls can be trusted, and why massive Republican spending can't outrun Trump's cost-of-living crisis and his war in Iran. They also dig into the strategy—or lack thereof—behind Trump's rally blitz, whether gerrymandering has backfired on the GOP, and why Democrats may actually perform better in red states than in blue ones this November.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It
programme.desc: Gas prices go up, Ukraine’s Starlink goes down, and Ilhan Omar is caught in the middle. This week, Ben Feldman of Ghosts and Superstore talks Netflix fame, the French-Canadian language police, and being a dirty little trailer pig (?), while Dusty Slay opens up about drag queens, ghost writers and private drawings. We shake our fist at costume parties, tiny plates and visiting L.A. for The Rant Wheel, and take our time saying farewell with Second Thoughts.

programme.title: This F*cking Guy
programme.desc: In our 49th episode of This F*cking Guy, Crooked’s Alex Wagner joins Erin to dive deep into the past of Trump’s Executive Task Rabbit, Marco Rubio. From fudging the truth about being the “son of Cuban exiles", to his gross hypocrisy on immigration, to befriending sleaze bags and corrupt world leaders like it’s his job, to cosplaying as Viceroy of Venezuela, this may be our most two-faced guy, yet!

programme.title: Offline with Jon Favreau
programme.desc: What would you do if your son texted you in the middle of the night that he'd stumbled upon a bizarre castle lorded over by a creepy man? For Jon Ronson, the journalist and bestselling author of So You've Been Publicly Shamed and The Psychopath Test, the answer is simple: write a book about it. The Castle: Adventures in a World of Unraveling Men is an empathetic, humorous, and startling investigation of men who are struggling to find purpose, connection, and place in a rapidly changing world. Jon and Jon talk about what happened to the institutions that once gave people a sense of belonging, how the internet has offered new—and sometimes dangerous—substitutes, and what all of this means for raising boys.

programme.title: This F*cking Guy
programme.desc: In our 48th episode of This F*cking Guy, Crooked’s Julia Claire joins Erin to dive deep into the past of the chronically concerned, Susan Collins. From her false promises to only serve two senate terms, to defending the filibuster more than voting rights, to her laughable lack of foresight and complicity in overturning Roe, to her cowardice hand-wringing and compliance with Trump and Republicans, this may be or most useless guy, yet!
